title: Savi Davison breaks down after PLDT’s semifinal hopes end

 Emotions got the better of Savannah Davison after PLDT High Speed Hitters’ campaign in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series came to an end following its four-set defeat to Choco Mucho Flying Titans on Thursday night.
 The Fil-Canadian hitter was seen in tears as the High Speed Hitters faced the disappointment of missing the semifinals after absorbing a 22-25, 23-25, 25-18, 23-25 loss at the SM Mall of Asia Arena.
 savi 😭😭😭😭😭 you did everything u could 🥺
 ©️ gawongst_0323 on tiktok https://t.co/RoawTLEuAw
 — Eya Larue (@rawrUSTe) November 19, 2026 
 Davison had done her part in keeping PLDT in contention, exploding for a game-high 30 points while adding 10 excellent digs and 22 receptions. However, her efforts were not enough to prevent Choco Mucho from securing the victory and advancing to the Final Four.
 The loss left PLDT with a 4-4 record and ended its hopes of joining the semifinal cast, while Choco Mucho advanced with a 5-3 finish.
 A social media post featuring Davison’s emotional moment drew messages of support, with one fan expressing sympathy for the PLDT import and recognizing her efforts despite the team’s elimination. (Adrian Co)
